falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 implies elevated volatility and stress; sustained VIX compression below 14 would demonstrate that market fear has fully cleared without the typical capitulation washout, invalidating the bottom call and suggesting a shallow correction rather than structural bottom
